senses: ἀ-σύνετος, -ον without understanding or discernment: [[r:MAT.15.16|Mat 15:16]], [[r:MRK.7.18|Mrk 7:18]] (Swete, in l), [[r:ROM.1.21|Rom 1:21, 31 10:19]] (for an ex. of its use in the moral sense, see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0802.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G4934]]
G0802.strongs: properly, not agreed, i.e. treacherous to compacts
senses: ἀ-σύν-θετος, -ον (συντίθεμαι ν. M, Pr., 222; MM, see word), false to engagements, not keeping covenant, faithless (MM, see word): [[r:ROM.1.31|Rom 1:31.]]† (AS)
security: [[r:ACT.5.23|Act 5:23]], [[r:1TH.5.3|1Th 5:3]]. (In π. it is used as a law-term, proof, security; see MM, see word; M, Th., l.with)† (AS)

G0804.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and sphallo (to "fail")
senses: (ἀ- neg., σφάλλω, to trip up), certain, secure, safe: [[r:ACT.21.34|Act 21:34 22:30 25:26]], [[r:PHP.3.1|Php 3:1]], [[r:HEB.6.19|Heb 6:19]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
(ἀσφαλής), to make firm, secure: mid., [[r:MAT.27.65|Mat 27:65-66]], [[r:ACT.16.24|Act 16:24]]; pass., [[r:MAT.27.64|Mat 27:64]] (MM, see word).† (AS)
(ἀσχήμαων), to act unbecomingly, behave dishonourably: [[r:1CO.13.5|1Co 13:5]]; before ἐπί, ib. [[r:1CO.7.36|1Co 7:36]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0808.strongs: an indecency; by implication, the pudenda
senses: (ἀσχήμων), unseemliness: [[r:ROM.1.27|Rom 1:27]] (MM, see word); euphemism for ἡ αἰσχύνη, as frequently in LXX, shame, nakedness: [[r:REV.16.15|Rev 16:15.]]† (AS)

G0809.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G2192]] (in the sense of its congener [[w:G4976]])

G0810.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [[w:G4982]]
senses: (ἀ- neg., σώζω), prodigality, wastefulness, profligacy: [[r:EPH.5.18|Eph 5:18]], [[r:TIT.1.6|Tit 1:6]], [[r:1PE.4.4|1Pe 4:4]] (MM, see word).† SYN.: ἀσέλγεια, q.v (AS)
ἀσώτως adv. (ἄσωτος, prodigal, wasteful), wastefully: [[r:LUK.15.13|Luk 15:13]] (EV, in riotous living; but not necessarily dissolute; cf. MM, ut supr.; Milligan, NTD, 79).† (AS)

ἀτακτέω -ῶ (ἄτακτος), primarily, of soldiers marching, to be out of order, to quit the ranks; hence, metaphorically, to be remiss, fail in the performance of duty (in π., of truancy on the part of an apprentice): [[r:2TH.3.7|2Th 3:7]] (on ἀ. and its cognates, see M, Th., 152 ff.; MM, s.vv.).† (AS)

G0813.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G5021]]
senses: ἀ-τακτος, -ον (τάσσω), out of order, out of place (Lat. inordinatus), frequently of soldiers not keeping the ranks, or an army in disarray (cf. [[r:3MA.1.19|3Ma 1:19]]); hence, metaphorically, irregular, disorderly (see previous word): [[r:1TH.5.14|1Th 5:14.]]† (AS)

G0816.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a particle of union) and τείνω (to stretch)
G0816.kjv: behold earnestly (stedfastly), fasten (eyes), look (earnestly, stedfastly, up stedfastly), set eyes
senses: (ἀτενής, strained, intent; τείνω), to look fixedly, gaze (MM, see word): with dative of person(s), gaze upon: [[r:LUK.4.20|Luk 4:20 22:56]], [[r:ACT.3.12|Act 3:12 10:4 14:9 23:1]]; before εἰς, with accusative of person(s), [[r:ACT.3.4|Act 3:4 6:15 13:9]]; metaphorically, [[r:ACT.1.10|Act 1:10 7:55 11:6]], [[r:2CO.3.7|2Co 3:7 3:13]].† (AS)

G0817.strongs: aloof, i.e. apart from (literally or figuratively)
senses: ἄτερ prep., in cl. most frequently in poets; without, apart from: with genitive, [[r:LUK.22.6|Luk 22:6, 35]] (for exx. from π., see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0818.strongs: to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat
G0818.kjv: despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully
senses: (ἄτιμος), to dishonour, insult: [[r:MRK.12.4|Mrk 12:4]], TTr., mg., WH, [[r:LUK.20.11|Luk 20:11]], [[r:JHN.8.49|Jhn 8:49]], [[r:ROM.2.23|Rom 2:23]], [[r:JAS.2.6|Jas 2:6]]; pass.: [[r:ACT.5.41|Act 5:41]], [[r:ROM.1.24|Rom 1:24]] (cf ἀτιμάω).† (AS)

(ἄτιμος) dishonour, disgrace: [[r:1CO.11.14|1Co 11:14]], [[r:2CO.6.8|2Co 6:8]]; εἰς ἀ., [[r:ROM.9.21|Rom 9:21]], [[r:2TI.2.20|2Ti 2:20]]; ἐν ἀ., [[r:1CO.15.43|1Co 15:43]]; κατ᾽ ἀ., [[r:2CO.11.21|2Co 11:21]]; πάθη ἀτιμίας, base passions, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26.]]† (AS)

G0820.kjv: despised, without honour, less honourable (comparative degree)

G0823.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and the base of [[w:G5114]]
G0823.strongs: uncut, i.e. (by implication) indivisible (an "atom" of time)
senses: ἄ-τομος, -ον (τέμνω), indivisible; of time, ἄτομον, a moment: ἐν ἄ., [[r:1CO.15.52|1Co 15:52.]]† (AS)

G0824.strongs: out of place, i.e. (figuratively) improper, injurious, wicked
senses: marvellous, strange (of symptoms, Hipp.): [[r:ACT.28.6|Act 28:6]]; hence, in late Greek, with ethical sense,
improper, unrighteous (so in LXX, and for exx. from π., see M, Th., l.with; MM, see word): [[r:LUK.23.41|Luk 23:41]], [[r:ACT.25.5|Act 25:5]], [[r:2TH.3.2|2Th 3:2]].† (AS)
(poët.), to see clearly (so perh. 2 Co, l.with; MM, see word)
as in LXX, to shine forth: [[r:2CO.4.4|2Co 4:4]] (cf. δι-, κατ-αυγάζω).† (AS)

G0827.strongs: a ray of light, i.e. (by implication) radiance, dawn
senses: Later (as in MGr.; MM, see word), daylight, dawn: [[r:ACT.20.11|Act 20:11]] (Cremer, 118).† SYN.: φέγγος (see Thayer, s. φ.; DB, iii, 44a; Tr., Syn., § xlvi). (AS)

G0828.strongs: Augustus, a title of the Roman emperor
senses: (Lat.), Augustus, the Roman Emperor: [[r:LUK.2.1|Luk 2:1]] (cf. Σεβαστός; and see MM, see word).† (AS)

G0830.kjv: of own accord, willing of self

G0831.root: from a compound of [[w:G0846]] and an obsolete ἕντης (a worker)
G0831.strongs: to act of oneself, i.e. (figuratively) dominate
senses: (αὐθέντης, i.e. αὐτο- ἕντης, one who acts on his own authority, in π., an autocrat; cf. [[r:WIS.12.6|Wis 12:6]]; cf. -ία, [[r:3MA.2.29|3Ma 2:29]]; -ικος is frequently in vernacular, MM, see word) to govern, exercise authority over: [[r:1TI.2.12|1Ti 2:12.]]† (AS)
(αὐλός), to play on a flute, to pipe: mid., [[r:MAT.11.17|Mat 11:17]], [[r:LUK.7.32|Luk 7:32]], [[r:1CO.14.7|1Co 14:7]].† (AS)

G0833.strongs: a yard (as open to the wind); by implication, a mansion
senses: in Hom., an open courtyard before a house, hence, an enclosure in the open, a sheepfold: [[r:JHN.10.1|Jhn 10:1, 16]]

the court, courtyard, round which a house is built: [[r:MAT.26.3|Mat 26:3, 58 26:69]], [[r:MRK.14.54|Mrk 14:54, 66 15:16]] [[r:LUK.11.21|Luk 11:21 22:55]], [[r:JHN.18.15|Jhn 18:15]]; τ. ναοῦ, [[r:REV.11.2|Rev 11:2.]] a dwelling, a palace (so, accusative to Grimm-Th., see word): [[r:MAT.26.3|Mat 26:3, 58]], [[r:MRK.14.54|Mrk 14:54 15:16]], [[r:LUK.11.21|Luk 11:21]], [[r:JHN.18.15|Jhn 18:15]] (but see MM, see word; cf. also DB, ii, 25, 287).† (AS)

G0835.strongs: to pass the night (properly, in the open air)
senses: prop., to lodge in a courtyard.
to pass the night, lodge (LXX; MM, see word): [[r:MAT.21.17|Mat 21:17]], [[r:LUK.21.37|Luk 21:37]].† (AS)

G0837.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb
G0837.strongs: to grow ("wax"), i.e. enlarge (literal or figurative, active or passive)
senses: (and the earlier form αὔξω, [[r:EPH.2.21|Eph 2:21]], [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19]]; MM, see word),

trans., to make to grow: [[r:1CO.3.6|1Co 3:6-7]], [[r:2CO.9.10|2Co 9:10]]. Pass., to grow, increase, become greater: [[r:MAT.13.32|Mat 13:32]], [[r:MRK.4.8|Mrk 4:8]], [[r:2CO.10.15|2Co 10:15]], [[r:COL.1.6|Col 1:6]]; τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τ. θεοῦ, [[r:COL.1.10|Col 1:10]]; εἰς σωτηρίαν, [[r:1PE.2.2|1Pe 2:2.]]

In later Gk. (but nowhere in LXX), intrans., to grow, increase: of plants, [[r:MAT.6.28|Mat 6:28]], [[r:LUK.12.27|Luk 12:27 13:19]]; of infants, [[r:LUK.1.80|Luk 1:80 2:40]]; of a multitude, [[r:ACT.7.17|Act 7:17]]; of the increase of the Gospel: ὁ λόγος ηὔξανε, [[r:ACT.6.7|Act 6:7 12:24 19:20]]; of Christ as a leader, [[r:JHN.3.30|Jhn 3:30]]; of Christian character: εἰς Χριοτόν, [[r:EPH.4.15|Eph 4:15]]; εἰς ναόν, [[r:EPH.2.21|Eph 2:21]]; ἐν χάριτι, [[r:2PE.3.18|2Pe 3:18]]; τὴν αὔξησιν τ. θεσῦ, [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19]] (cf. συν, ὑπερ-αυξάνω).† (AS)

G0839.root: from a derivative of the same as [[w:G0109]] (meaning a breeze, i.e. the morning air)
G0839.strongs: properly, fresh, i.e. (adverb with ellipsis of) to-morrow

G0840.root: from a (presumed) derivative of the same as [[w:G0109]] (meaning blown)
G0840.strongs: rough (properly as a gale), i.e. (figuratively) severe
senses: (αἄω, to dry up) prop., stringent, harsh to the taste. Metaphorical, in Inscr., of a rough country; of disposition and manners, strict, severe (as in π., of an inspector; MM, s v): [[r:LUK.19.21|Luk 19:21-22.]]† SYN.: σκληρός (Tr., § xiv) (AS)

G0841.strongs: self-satisfaction, i.e. (abstractly) contentedness, or (concretely) a competence
senses: sufficiency (MM, see word): in subjective sense (see Milligan, NTD, 57), [[r:2CO.9.8|2Co 9:8]];

(αὐτός, ἀρκέω), as in cl., in philosophical sense, self-­sufficient, independent; subjectively, contented: [[r:PHP.4.11|Php 4:11]] (in non-lit. π., the word means simply enough, sufficient; MM, see word).† (AS)
αὐτόματος -ον, and -η, -ον (etym. doubtful; see Boisacq, Prellwitz, see word),
of persons, acting of one's own will.
Of inanimate things and natural agencies, of itself, of its own accord: γῆ [[r:MRK.4.28|Mrk 4:28]] (MM, see word); πύλη, [[r:ACT.12.10|Act 12:10.]]† (AS)

G0846.root: from the particle αὖ (perhaps akin to the base of [[w:G0109]] through the idea of a baffling wind) (backward)
G0846.strongs: the reflexive pronoun self, used (alone or in the comparative) of the third person, and (with the proper personal pronoun) of the other persons
G0846.kjv: her, it(-self), one, the other, (mine) own, said, (self-), the) same, ((him-, my-, thy-)self, (your-)selves, she, that, their(-s), them(-selves), there(-at, - by, -in, -into, -of, -on, -with), they, (these) things, this (man), those, together, very, which
senses: determinative pron., in late Gk. much more frequently than in cl. (WM, 178f.; Jannaris, HGG, §1399).

Emphatic (so always in nom. exc. when preceded by the art., see infr., iii); (1) self (ipse), expressing opposition, distinction, exclusion, etc., αὐ. ἐκχυθήσεται, [[r:LUK.5.37|Luk 5:37]]; αὐ. ἐγινώσκεν, [[r:JHN.2.25|Jhn 2:25]]; αὐ.ὑμεῖς, [[r:JHN.3.28|Jhn 3:28]]; καὶ αὐ. ἐγώ, [[r:ROM.15.14|Rom 15:14]]; αὐ. Ἰησοῦς, [[r:JHN.2.24|Jhn 2:24]]; αὐ. καὶ οἱ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ, [[r:MRK.2.25|Mrk 2:25]]; ὑμεῖς αὐ., [[r:MRK.6.31|Mrk 6:31]]; esp. (as freq in cl.) αὐ. ὁ, [[r:MAT.3.4|Mat 3:4]], [[r:MRK.6.17|Mrk 6:17]], [[r:JHN.16.27|Jhn 16:27]], [[r:1TH.3.11|1Th 3:11]], al.; in late Gk., sometimes weakened, ἐν αὐτῇ τ. ὥρᾳ, in that hour, [[r:LUK.10.21|Luk 10:21]] (M, Pr., 91; MM, see word); (2) emphatic, he, she, it (M, Pr., 86; Bl., §48, 1, 2, 7), [[r:MAT.1.21|Mat 1:21, 12:50]], [[r:LUK.6.35|Luk 6:35]], al.; pointing to some one as master (cl.), [[r:MAT.8.24|Mat 8:24]], [[r:MRK.4.38|Mrk 4:38]], al.; αὐ., καὶ αὐ. = οὗτος, ὁ δε (BL, §48, 1), [[r:MAT.14.2|Mat 14:2]], [[r:MRK.14.15|Mrk 14:15, 44]], [[r:LUK.1.22|Luk 1:22, 2:28]], al.

In oblique cases (cl.), for the simple pron. of 3rd of person(s), he, she, it, [[r:MAT.7.9|Mat 7:9, 10:12, 26:44]], al.; with ptcp. in genitive absol., [[r:MAT.9.18|Mat 9:18]], [[r:MRK.13.1|Mrk 13:1]], al. (for irreg. constructions, V. Bl., §74, 5); pleonastically after the relative (cf. Heb. אֲשֶׁר לוֹ; WM, 184ff.; Bl., §50, 4; MM, see word), [[r:MRK.7.25|Mrk 7:25]], [[r:REV.3.8|Rev 3:8, 7:2]], al.; in constr. ad sensum, without proper subject expressly indicated, [[r:MAT.4.23|Mat 4:23]], [[r:ACT.8.5|Act 8:5]], [[r:2CO.2.13|2Co 2:13]], al.; genitive αὐτοῦ = ἐκείνου, [[r:ROM.11.11|Rom 11:11]], [[r:1TH.2.19|1Th 2:19]], [[r:TIT.3.5|Tit 3:5]], [[r:HEB.2.4|Heb 2:4]].

ὁ, ἡ, τὸ αὐ., the same: [[r:HEB.1.12|Heb 1:12, 13:8]]; τὸ αὐ., ποιεῖν, [[r:MAT.5.46|Mat 5:46, 47]], al.; φρονεῖν, [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16, 15:5]], [[r:PHP.2.2|Php 2:2]], al.; τὰ αὐ., [[r:ACT.15.27|Act 15:27]], [[r:ROM.2.1|Rom 2:1]], al.; κατὰ τὸ (τὰ) αὐ. (MM, see word), [[r:ACT.14.1|Act 14:1]], [[r:LUK.6.23|Luk 6:23]], al.; ἐπὶ τὸ αὐ., together (MM, see word), [[r:MAT.22.34|Mat 22:34]], [[r:ACT.1.15|Act 1:15]], al.; ἓν κ. τὸ αὐ., [[r:1CO.11.5|1Co 11:5, 12:11]]; with dative (cl.), [[r:1CO.11.5|1Co 11:5]]; with a noun, λόγος, [[r:MRK.14.39|Mrk 14:39]]; μέτρος, [[r:PHP.1.30|Php 1:30]]; πνεῦμα, [[r:1CO.12.4|1Co 12:4.]] (AS)

G0847.root: genitive (i.e. possessive) of [[w:G0846]], used as an adverb of location
G0847.strongs: properly, belonging to the same spot, i.e. in this (or that) place
senses: αὐτοῦ adv., prop. neut. genitive of αὐτός, there: [[r:MAT.26.36|Mat 26:36]], [[r:MRK.6.33|Mrk 6:33]], WH, mg., [[r:LUK.9.27|Luk 9:27]], [[r:ACT.15.34|Act 15:34]], WH, mg., R, mg., [[r:ACT.18.19|Act 18:19 21:4]].† (AS)

G0848.strongs: self (in some oblique case or reflexively, relation)
G0848.kjv: her (own), (of) him(-self), his (own), of it, thee, their (own), them(-selves), they

senses: αὐτό-χειρ, -ρος, ὁ, ἡ (αὐτός, χείρ), with one's own hand: [[r:ACT.27.19|Act 27:19.]]† (AS)

G0850.root: from αὐχμός (probably from a base akin to that of [[w:G0109]]) (dust, as dried by wind)

senses: ἀφ-αιρέω, -ῶ to take from, take away, take off: with accusative, τὸ ὠτίον, [[r:MAT.26.51|Mat 26:51]], [[r:MRK.14.47|Mrk 14:47]] (ὠτάριον, WH), [[r:LUK.22.50|Luk 22:50]] (οὖς); ὄνειδος, [[r:LUK.1.25|Luk 1:25]]; before ἀπό, [[r:REV.22.19|Rev 22:19]], [[r:LUK.16.3|Luk 16:3]] (mid.); pass., C. genitive, [[r:LUK.10.42|Luk 10:42]]; ἀ. ἁμαρτίος, [[r:HEB.10.4|Heb 10:4]], [[r:ROM.11.27|Rom 11:27]] (mid.) (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0853.strongs: to render unapparent, i.e. (actively) consume (becloud), or (passively) disappear (be destroyed)
senses: to make unseen, hide from sight (Xen., a1.).

G0855.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G5316]]
senses: (φαίνομαι), poët. and late prose (MM, see word) invisible, hidden: [[r:LUK.24.31|Luk 24:31.]]† (AS)

G0856.root: from a compound of [[w:G0575]] and the base of [[w:G1476]]
G0856.strongs: a place of sitting apart, i.e. a privy
senses: (cf. ἄφεδρος, [[r:LEV.12.5|Lev 12:5]]) = cl. ἄφοδος (MM, see word), a privy, drain: [[r:MAT.15.17|Mat 15:17]], [[r:MRK.7.19|Mrk 7:19]] (ὀχετόν, WH, mg.).† **ὀχετός, -οῦ, ὁ (ὀχέω, to carry)

G0857.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and [[w:G5339]]

G0858.root: from a compound of [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and φέλλος (in the sense of a stone as stubbing the foot)

senses: Metaphorical, of sins (never in LXX), pardon, remission of penalty: ἁμαρτιῶν, [[r:MAT.26.28|Mat 26:28]], [[r:MRK.1.4|Mrk 1:4]], [[r:LUK.1.77|Luk 1:77 3:3 24:47]], [[r:ACT.2.38|Act 2:38 5:31 10:43 13:38 26:18]], [[r:COL.1.14|Col 1:14]]; παραπτωμάτων, [[r:EPH.1.7|Eph 1:7]]; absol., [[r:MRK.3.29|Mrk 3:29]], [[r:HEB.9.22|Heb 9:22 10:18]] (cf. DB, ii, 56; DCG, i, 437, ii, 605; Cremer, 297 f.).† SYN.: πάρεσις, which see (and cf. Tr., § xxxiii) (AS)
(ἅπτω, to fasten, fit), a joint (MM, see word): [[r:EPH.4.16|Eph 4:16]], [[r:COL.2.19|Col 2:19]] (Lft., in l).† (AS)

(ἄφθαρτος), incorruptibility, immortality: [[r:ROM.2.7|Rom 2:7]], [[r:1CO.15.42|1Co 15:42 15:50 15:53-54]], [[r:2TI.1.10|2Ti 1:10]]; ἀγαπώντων... ἐν ἀ., [[r:EPH.6.24|Eph 6:24]] (see AR, in l).† ἀ-φθορία, -ας, ἡ (φθείρω), uncorruptness: [[r:TIT.2.7|Tit 2:7]] (Rec. ἀφθορία).† (AS)

G0862.root: from [[w:G0001]] (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [[w:G5351]]
senses: of persons: of men, [[r:1CO.15.52|1Co 15:52]]; of God, [[r:ROM.1.23|Rom 1:23]], [[r:1TI.1.17|1Ti 1:17]] (MM, see word).† (AS)

G0863.strongs: an intensive form of, to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow)
G0863.kjv: cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up
senses: to send forth, send away, let go: of divorce (DB, iii, 274a), τ. γυναῖκα (Hdt.), [[r:1CO.7.11|1Co 7:11-13]]; of death, τ. πνεῦμα ([[r:GEN.35.18|Gen 35:18]], Hdt., al.), [[r:MAT.27.50|Mat 27:50]]; (φωνήν, to utter a cry, [[r:MRK.15.37|Mrk 15:37]]; of debts, to remit, forgive (cl.), τ. δανεῖον, [[r:MAT.18.27|Mat 18:27]]; τ. ὀφειλήν, [[r:MAT.18.32|Mat 18:32]]; esp. of sins (Cremer 296f.), τ. ἁμαρτίας, ἁμαρτήματα, ἀνομίας, [[r:MAT.9.2|Mat 9:2]], [[r:ROM.4.7|Rom 4:7]]" (LXX), [[r:1JN.1.9|1Jn 1:9]], al.; punctiliar and iterative present (M, Pr., 119), Mrk 2:5, [[r:LUK.11.4|Luk 11:4]]; Ion. pf., ἀφέωνται (M, Pr., 38), [[r:LUK.5.23|Luk 5:23.]]

to leave alone, leave, neglect: [[r:MAT.4.11|Mat 4:11 5:24 15:14]], [[r:MRK.1.20|Mrk 1:20, 31]] [[r:JHN.4.3|Jhn 4:3, 28]] al.; τ. ἐντολὴν τ. θεοῦ, [[r:MRK.7.8|Mrk 7:8]]; τον̀ τ. ἀρχῆς τ. Χριστοῦ λόγον, [[r:HEB.6.1|Heb 6:1]]; τ. ἀγάπην τ. πρώτην, [[r:REV.2.4|Rev 2:4]]; ptcp., ἀφείς, pleonastic (as in Aram.; M, Pr., 14; Dalman, Words, 21f.), [[r:MAT.13.36|Mat 13:36 22:22]], [[r:MRK.8.13|Mrk 8:13]], al.

to let, suffer, permit: [[r:MAT.3.15|Mat 3:15]]; with accusative, [[r:MAT.3.15|Mat 3:15, 19:14]], al.; with accusative of thing(s) and dative of person(s), [[r:MAT.5.40|Mat 5:40]]; with inf. pres., [[r:MAT.23.14|Mat 23:14]], al.; aor., [[r:MRK.5.37|Mrk 5:37]], al.; in late Gk. (M, Pr., 175f.), before ἵνα, [[r:MRK.11.16|Mrk 11:16]], [[r:JHN.12.7|Jhn 12:7]]; with subjunct. (M, Pr., l.with; Bl., §64, 2), [[r:MAT.7.4|Mat 7:4 27:49]], [[r:MRK.15.36|Mrk 15:36]], [[r:LUK.6.42|Luk 6:42]] (see further MM, see word). (AS)
ἀφ-ικνέομαι, -οῦμαι perfective of ἱκνέομαι, to come (M, Pr., 247), to arrive at, come to, reach: metaphorically (MM, see word), [[r:ROM.16.19|Rom 16:19.]]† (AS)

G0865.kjv: despiser of those that are good
senses: ἀ-φιλ-άγαθος, -ον without love of good: [[r:2TI.3.3|2Ti 3:3]] (not elsewhere in Gk. lit., but see MM, see word).† (AS)
